entities.summary: Astrid Linder is a Swedish engineer and researcher in motor vehicle safety. She created the first average-sized female crash test dummy. For her contributions to the field, Linder was awarded EU Champions of Transport Research Competition and U.S. Government Award for Safety Engineering Excellence. In November 2023, Linder was named to the BBC's 100 Women list.
